texts.short: おはよう。今日もよろしくね。
texts.long: 今日は朝から少し雨が降っていたけれど、窓を開けると涼しい風が入ってきて、気持ちがよかった。午後になったら図書館へ行って、前から読みたかった本を探してみようと思う。帰りには駅の近くのお店で温かいお茶を飲みながら、明日の予定をゆっくり考えたいな。

measurement.percentiles: Two hot samples per case; median means their midpoint, not a stable population estimate
measurement.background_load: Not independently quantified; no isolated-GPU claim
measurement.package_preparation: Native model conversion/reference preparation completed before the process benchmarks
measurement.timing_scope: Request timers end at complete PCM delivery; file writing is excluded; resource polling is active
measurement.memory_scope: Process-tree sampled Windows working set and private bytes; shared pages may be double counted. Separate WDDM resource probe recorded below; do not add its counters to RSS.
measurement.source_revision: Working tree measurement; harness hash retained, complete executed runtime-source snapshot not captured

execution.threads: Original ORT defaults; no session or model patches
execution.model_identity: Preconverted Genie assets are hashed; original checkpoint provenance is unverified

cpu_gpt_exploration.scope: Alternating C/F layouts on this CPU, one saved fixed history. Decoder-only exploration, not a generalized end-to-end speedup.

acoustic_probe.timing_scope: Profiling enabled. Wall time covers CPU inputs to returned CPU waveform; repeat 0 is the first invocation of each case. Summed provider event durations can overlap and are not device utilization, exclusive GPU kernel time or end-to-end speed.

managed_lifecycle.scope: Real HTTP wake, one short text request, explicit sleep; functionality checks, not hot throughput measurement

metadata.measurement: process-attributed WDDM counters; not exclusive VRAM
metadata.aggregation: none; shared allocations may be counted for multiple PIDs
metadata.residency: Total Committed is not a residency measurement

wddm_resource_probe.scope: Separate WDDM resource probe. Includes sampler overhead; do not replace end-to-end timing benchmark. Process-attributed counters may overlap process RSS and are not summed into total RAM.
wddm_resource_probe.missing_instance_interpretation: Unavailable after process exit, not a measured zero allocation

initial_attempt.reason: Windows venv launcher is not the model process; rerun sampled its complete owned process tree
